<style>
#adm-root{
  min-height:300px
}
.adm-users-card{
  margin-top:12px
}
.adm-google-access{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  margin:8px 0 10px;
  padding:9px 10px;
  border:1px solid #c6dce1;
  border-radius:8px;
  background:#f3f9fa
}
.adm-google-access strong{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  color:#143f53;
  font-size:10.5px
}
.adm-google-access p{
  flex:1 1 auto;
  margin:0
}
.adm-google-access button{
  flex:0 0 auto
}
.adm-profile-guide{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:7px;
  margin:9px 0 12px
}
.adm-profile-card{
  min-width:0;
  padding:9px;
  border:1px solid #cbdde2;
  border-radius:8px;
  background:#f7fbfc
}
.adm-profile-card strong{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:3px;
  color:#123e52;
  font-size:11px
}
.adm-profile-card>.hint{
  display:block;
  min-height:44px;
  line-height:1.2;
  font-size:9.5px
}
.adm-profile-defaults{
  display:block;
  margin-top:6px;
  padding-top:5px;
  border-top:1px solid #e0eaed;
  color:#56717c;
  font-size:8.8px;
  line-height:1.25
}
.adm-user-list{
  margin-top:8px
}
.adm-user-box{
  margin:6px 0;
  border-color:#c5d9df;
  background:rgba(250,253,253,.97)
}
.adm-user-box>summary{
  color:#173e51;
  font-weight:700
}
.adm-user-add{
  margin-top:10px;
  border-color:#8eb9c2;
  background:#f2f9fa
}
.adm-user-editor{
  margin-top:5px
}
.adm-selected-profile{
  margin:5px 0 7px;
  padding:6px 8px;
  border-left:3px solid #178394;
  border-radius:4px;
  color:#315865;
  background:#eef7f8;
  font-size:10px
}
.adm-permission-help{
  margin:3px 0 7px;
  color:#5c737d;
  font-size:9.5px;
  line-height:1.25
}
.adm-user-form>.grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:7px
}
.adm-user-form>.grid>.field[data-field="nome"],
.adm-user-form>.grid>.field[data-field="funcao"]{
  grid-column:span 2
}
.adm-user-form>.grid>.field[data-field^="perm_"]{
  min-height:62px;
  padding:7px 8px;
  border:1px solid #d5e3e7;
  border-radius:7px;
  background:#f9fcfc
}
.adm-user-form>.grid>.field[data-field^="perm_"]>span{
  min-height:30px;
  color:#31525f;
  font-size:9.3px;
  line-height:1.2
}
.adm-user-form>.grid>.field[data-field^="perm_"] input[type="checkbox"]{
  margin-top:4px
}
.adm-user-form input[readonly]{
  color:#536a74;
  background:#edf3f5;
  cursor:not-allowed
}
.adm-user-form>.actions{
  justify-content:flex-end
}
@media(max-width:1150px){
  .adm-profile-guide{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))
  }
  .adm-user-form>.grid{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))
  }
}
@media(max-width:680px){
  .adm-google-access{
    align-items:stretch;
    flex-direction:column
  }
  .adm-google-access button{
    width:100%
  }
  .adm-profile-guide,
  .adm-user-form>.grid{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
  .adm-user-form>.grid>.field[data-field="nome"],
  .adm-user-form>.grid>.field[data-field="funcao"]{
    grid-column:auto
  }
  .adm-user-form>.actions{
    justify-content:stretch
  }
  .adm-user-form>.actions button{
    width:100%
  }
}

.adm-autocadastro-steps{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:6px;
  margin:9px 0 11px
}
.adm-autocadastro-step{
  padding:8px 9px;
  border:1px solid #d2e2e6;
  border-radius:8px;
  color:#486775;
  background:#f7fbfc;
  font-size:9.2px;
  line-height:1.35
}
@media(max-width:680px){
  .adm-autocadastro-steps{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
}


.adm-user-danger{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  margin-top:12px;
  padding:10px 11px;
  border:1px solid #e4bbb6;
  border-radius:9px;
  background:#fff6f4
}
.adm-user-danger-copy{
  min-width:0
}
.adm-user-danger-copy strong{
  display:block;
  color:#8a332c;
  font-size:10px
}
.adm-user-danger-copy span{
  display:block;
  margin-top:2px;
  color:#815f5b;
  font-size:8.8px;
  line-height:1.35
}
.adm-user-delete-button{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  min-height:30px;
  padding:6px 10px;
  color:#fff!important;
  border-color:#b74439!important;
  background:#b74439!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
  font-size:9px
}
.adm-user-delete-button:hover{
  border-color:#96352d!important;
  background:#96352d!important
}
@media(max-width:680px){
  .adm-user-danger{
    align-items:stretch;
    flex-direction:column
  }
  .adm-user-delete-button{
    width:100%
  }
}


.adm-function-approval{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  margin:10px 0;
  padding:10px 11px;
  border-radius:9px
}
.adm-function-approval.pending{
  border:1px solid #dec78e;
  background:#fff9e8
}
.adm-function-approval.approved{
  border:1px solid #b8d8cf;
  background:#eef8f5
}
.adm-function-approval>div{
  min-width:0
}
.adm-function-approval strong{
  display:block;
  color:#274d59;
  font-size:10px
}
.adm-function-approval span{
  display:block;
  margin-top:2px;
  color:#647b84;
  font-size:8.8px;
  line-height:1.35
}
.adm-function-approval button{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  min-height:31px;
  font-size:9px
}
@media(max-width:680px){
  .adm-function-approval{
    align-items:stretch;
    flex-direction:column
  }
  .adm-function-approval button{
    width:100%
  }
}


.adm-oauth-info{
  margin:9px 0 11px
}
.adm-oauth-info>div{
  padding:9px 10px;
  border:1px solid #d0e1e5;
  border-radius:8px;
  background:#f7fbfc
}
.adm-oauth-info strong{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:4px;
  color:#315765;
  font-size:9px
}
.adm-oauth-info code{
  display:block;
  overflow:auto;
  color:#0b6673;
  font-size:8.5px;
  white-space:nowrap
}



/* Administração V2 — colunas, permissões e tags */
.adm-users-layout{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(240px,.72fr) minmax(0,1.8fr);
  grid-template-rows:auto auto;
  gap:12px;
  align-items:start;
  margin-top:10px
}
.adm-profile-guide{
  grid-column:1;
  grid-row:1 / span 2;
  position:sticky;
  top:12px;
  display:grid!important;
  grid-template-columns:1fr!important;
  gap:7px!important;
  margin:0!important
}
.adm-user-list{
  grid-column:2;
  grid-row:1;
  margin:0!important
}
.adm-user-add{
  grid-column:2;
  grid-row:2;
  margin:0!important
}
.adm-profile-card{
  min-height:0!important;
  padding:9px!important
}
.adm-profile-card strong{
  font-size:9.5px!important
}
.adm-profile-card span,
.adm-profile-card small{
  font-size:7.5px!important
}
.adm-user-box{
  margin:0 0 7px!important
}
.adm-user-box>summary{
  padding:9px 10px!important
}
.adm-user-editor{
  padding:3px 1px 5px
}
.adm-user-form>.grid{
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))!important
}
.adm-user-form>.grid>.field[data-field="nome"],
.adm-user-form>.grid>.field[data-field="funcao"],
.adm-user-form>.grid>.field[data-field="email"]{
  grid-column:span 1!important
}
.adm-user-form>.grid>.field[data-field^="perm_"]{
  min-height:54px!important
}
.adm-tags-card{
  margin-top:12px!important
}
.adm-tags-grid{
  display:grid;
  gap:7px;
  margin-top:10px
}
.adm-tag-row{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:120px minmax(170px,1fr) 48px 80px auto;
  gap:8px;
  align-items:center;
  padding:8px;
  border:1px solid #d9ddd8;
  border-radius:10px;
  background:#fffdfa
}
.adm-tag-preview{
  display:inline-flex;
  justify-content:center;
  align-items:center;
  min-height:28px;
  padding:4px 8px;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--tag-preview-color,#176e7d) 45%,white);
  border-radius:999px;
  color:var(--tag-preview-color,#176e7d);
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tag-preview-color,#176e7d) 10%,white);
  font-size:7.5px;
  font-weight:850
}
.adm-tag-row input[type="color"]{
  width:42px!important;
  min-height:34px!important;
  padding:2px!important
}
.adm-tag-active{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:5px;
  font-size:8px
}
.adm-tag-actions{
  display:flex;
  gap:5px;
  justify-content:flex-end
}
.adm-tag-actions button{
  min-height:32px!important;
  padding:5px 8px!important;
  font-size:8px!important
}
@media(max-width:1080px){
  .adm-users-layout{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
  .adm-profile-guide,
  .adm-user-list,
  .adm-user-add{
    grid-column:1;
    grid-row:auto;
    position:static
  }
  .adm-profile-guide{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important
  }
  .adm-user-form>.grid{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important
  }
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .adm-tag-row{
    grid-template-columns:1fr 50px;
  }
  .adm-tag-preview,
  .adm-tag-active,
  .adm-tag-actions{
    grid-column:span 2
  }
  .adm-tag-actions{
    justify-content:flex-start
  }
  .adm-user-form>.grid,
  .adm-profile-guide{
    grid-template-columns:1fr!important
  }
}


/* =========================================================
   ADMINISTRAÇÃO V3 — ABAS LAZY / LISTA + EDITOR
   ========================================================= */
.adm-v3-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-end;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:14px;
  margin-bottom:10px
}
.adm-v3-head h2{
  margin:0!important
}
.adm-v3-tabs{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  justify-content:flex-end;
  gap:5px
}
.adm-v3-tabs button{
  min-height:32px!important;
  padding:6px 9px!important;
  color:#3c5b66!important;
  border:1px solid #d4ddd9!important;
  background:#fffdfa!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;
  font-size:7.8px!important
}
.adm-v3-tabs button.active{
  color:#fff!important;
  border-color:var(--pda-sea)!important;
  background:var(--pda-sea)!important
}
.adm-v3-panel{
  min-height:280px
}
.adm-v3-loading{
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  min-height:220px;
  color:#778581;
  border:1px dashed #d7d3ca;
  border-radius:12px;
  background:#faf8f3;
  font-size:9px
}
.adm-v3-toolbar{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:flex-end;
  gap:7px;
  margin-bottom:9px;
  padding:9px 10px;
  border:1px solid #ddd9d0;
  border-radius:11px;
  background:#fffdfa
}
.adm-v3-toolbar input[type="search"]{
  flex:1 1 420px;
  min-height:35px!important
}
.adm-v3-toolbar>p{
  flex:1 1 auto;
  margin:0!important
}
.adm-v3-toolbar button{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  min-height:32px!important;
  font-size:7.8px!important
}
.adm-users-v3-layout{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(230px,.72fr) minmax(0,1.8fr);
  gap:10px;
  align-items:start
}
.adm-users-v3-list{
  max-height:690px;
  overflow:auto;
  border:1px solid #ddd9d0;
  border-radius:11px;
  background:#fffdfa
}
.adm-user-v3-item{
  display:grid!important;
  gap:2px!important;
  width:100%!important;
  min-height:51px!important;
  padding:9px 10px!important;
  border:0!important;
  border-bottom:1px solid #ebe6dd!important;
  border-radius:0!important;
  color:#34545f!important;
  text-align:left!important;
  background:transparent!important;
  box-shadow:none!important
}
.adm-user-v3-item:last-child{
  border-bottom:0!important
}
.adm-user-v3-item:hover{
  transform:none!important;
  background:#f1f6f4!important
}
.adm-user-v3-item.active{
  color:#fff!important;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0f6673,#0b5668)!important;
  box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--pda-coral)!important
}
.adm-user-v3-item strong{
  overflow:hidden;
  font-size:8.8px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.adm-user-v3-item small{
  overflow:hidden;
  color:#778783;
  font-size:7.2px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.adm-user-v3-item.active small{
  color:#d7e9ea
}
.adm-users-v3-editor{
  min-width:0;
  padding:14px;
  border:1px solid #ddd9d0;
  border-radius:11px;
  background:#fffdfa;
  box-shadow:var(--pda-shadow-soft)
}
.adm-users-v3-editor>h3{
  margin:0 0 10px!important;
  color:#254a56!important;
  font-family:var(--pda-display)!important;
  font-size:18px!important
}
.adm-user-v3-basics{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:7px
}
.adm-user-v3-form>h4{
  margin:13px 0 6px;
  color:#385862;
  font-size:9px
}
.adm-permission-v3-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:6px
}
.adm-permission-v3-item{
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-start;
  gap:7px;
  min-height:58px;
  padding:8px;
  border:1px solid #dde4e1;
  border-radius:9px;
  background:#f8faf7
}
.adm-permission-v3-item input{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  margin-top:2px
}
.adm-permission-v3-item>span{
  display:grid;
  gap:2px;
  min-width:0
}
.adm-permission-v3-item strong{
  color:#35545e;
  font-size:8px
}
.adm-permission-v3-item small{
  color:#788681;
  font-size:6.8px;
  line-height:1.3
}
.adm-user-v3-form>.actions{
  justify-content:flex-end;
  margin-top:10px
}
.adm-user-v3-form .danger{
  color:#91372f!important;
  border-color:#dfb6b0!important;
  background:#fff6f4!important
}

/* Tags */
.adm-tags-grid-v3{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:8px
}
.adm-tag-row-v3,
.adm-tag-editor-v3{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(120px,1fr) auto auto;
  gap:8px;
  align-items:center;
  padding:9px 10px;
  border:1px solid #ddd9d0;
  border-radius:10px;
  background:#fffdfa
}
.adm-tag-editor-v3{
  grid-column:1/-1;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,1fr) 90px 90px auto auto
}
.adm-tag-chip-v3{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  width:max-content;
  max-width:100%;
  min-height:27px;
  padding:4px 9px;
  border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--tag-color,#176e7d) 42%,white);
  border-radius:999px;
  color:var(--tag-color,#176e7d);
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tag-color,#176e7d) 9%,white);
  font-size:7.5px;
  font-weight:850
}
.adm-tag-row-v3 small{
  color:#77847f;
  font-size:7px
}

/* Modelo / APIs */
.adm-v3-card{
  max-width:880px;
  margin:0 auto 10px!important
}
.adm-v3-card input[type="file"]{
  display:block;
  width:100%;
  margin:8px 0
}
.adm-v3-card>.field{
  margin-top:8px
}

/* Configurações */
.adm-config-v3-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:8px
}
.adm-config-v3-item{
  display:grid;
  gap:7px;
  align-content:start;
  padding:11px;
  border:1px solid #ddd9d0;
  border-radius:10px;
  background:#fffdfa
}
.adm-config-v3-item strong{
  color:#31515c;
  font-size:8.5px
}
.adm-config-v3-item textarea{
  min-height:110px
}
.adm-config-v3-item button{
  justify-self:end
}

@media(max-width:1080px){
  .adm-permission-v3-grid{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))
  }
  .adm-users-v3-layout{
    grid-template-columns:minmax(190px,.62fr) minmax(0,1.5fr)
  }
}
@media(max-width:780px){
  .adm-v3-head,
  .adm-v3-toolbar{
    align-items:stretch;
    flex-direction:column
  }
  .adm-v3-toolbar input[type="search"]{
    flex:0 0 auto;
    width:100%;
    min-height:42px!important;
    height:42px!important;
    max-height:42px!important
  }
  .adm-v3-tabs{
    justify-content:flex-start
  }
  .adm-users-v3-layout,
  .adm-user-v3-basics,
  .adm-permission-v3-grid,
  .adm-tags-grid-v3,
  .adm-config-v3-grid{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
  .adm-users-v3-list{
    max-height:290px
  }
  .adm-tag-editor-v3{
    grid-template-columns:1fr 90px
  }
  .adm-tag-editor-v3>*{
    min-width:0
  }
}


/* Biblioteca visual */
.adm-images-intro{
  display:grid;
  gap:12px;
  margin-bottom:12px!important
}
.adm-image-upload{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(260px,1fr) auto;
  gap:10px;
  align-items:end
}
.adm-image-uses,
.adm-image-card-uses{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  gap:7px
}
.adm-image-use,
.adm-image-card-uses label{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:6px;
  padding:6px 8px;
  border:1px solid #d2deda;
  border-radius:999px;
  background:#f7faf8;
  font-size:8px;
  cursor:pointer
}
.adm-image-use input,
.adm-image-card-uses input{
  margin:0
}
.adm-image-count{
  margin:2px 0 8px!important
}
.adm-image-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:10px
}
.adm-image-card{
  display:grid;
  gap:9px;
  min-width:0;
  padding:10px;
  border:1px solid #d7dfdc;
  border-radius:12px;
  background:#fffdfa;
  box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(13,50,60,.05)
}
.adm-image-card.is-disabled{
  opacity:.62
}
.adm-image-preview{
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  min-height:120px;
  overflow:hidden;
  border:1px dashed #cbd9d6;
  border-radius:9px;
  background:#eef4f1;
  cursor:pointer
}
.adm-image-preview.is-loading{
  opacity:.6
}
.adm-image-preview img{
  display:block;
  width:100%;
  height:150px;
  object-fit:cover
}
.adm-image-card>strong{
  overflow:hidden;
  color:#173f49;
  font-size:9px;
  text-overflow:ellipsis;
  white-space:nowrap
}
.adm-image-card .field{
  gap:4px
}
.adm-image-card .actions{
  margin-top:2px!important
}
@media(max-width:1100px){
  .adm-image-grid{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))
  }
  .adm-image-upload{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .adm-image-grid{
    grid-template-columns:1fr
  }
}

.adm-user-editor-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:10px;
  margin-bottom:8px
}
.adm-user-editor-head h3{margin:0!important}
.adm-user-delete-top{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  min-height:32px!important;
  padding:6px 10px!important;
  color:#fff!important;
  border-color:#b74439!important;
  background:#b74439!important;
  box-shadow:none!important
}

  border-color:#96352d!important;
  background:#96352d!important
}

    align-items:stretch;
    flex-direction:column
  }
  .adm-user-delete-top{width:100%}
}

script:
<script>
window.PDA_MODULES.ADM=(()=>{
  const {el,button,call,status,alive}=App;

  function readFile_(file){
    return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
      const reader=new FileReader();
      reader.onload=()=>{
        const value=String(reader.result||'');
        const parts=value.split(',');
        if(parts.length<2){
          reject(new Error('Não foi possível ler o arquivo.'));
          return;
        }
        resolve(parts[1]);
      };
      reader.onerror=()=>reject(reader.error||new Error('Erro ao ler o arquivo.'));
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    });
  }

  async function optimizeImage_(file){
    if(!file){
      throw new Error('Selecione uma imagem.');
    }

    if(
      !/^image\/(jpeg|png|webp)$/.test(
        file.type||
        ''
      )
    ){
      throw new Error(
        'Use imagens JPEG, PNG ou WebP.'
      );
    }

    if(file.size>12*1024*1024){
      throw new Error(
        'A imagem original deve ter no máximo 12 MB.'
      );
    }

    const url=
      URL.createObjectURL(
        file
      );

    try{
      const image=
        new Image();

      image.src=url;
      await image.decode();

      const maxWidth=1800;
      const maxHeight=1200;
      const scale=
        Math.min(
          1,
          maxWidth/image.width,
          maxHeight/image.height
        );

      const canvas=
        document.createElement(
          'canvas'
        );

      canvas.width=
        Math.max(
          1,
          Math.round(
            image.width*
            scale
          )
        );

      canvas.height=
        Math.max(
          1,
          Math.round(
            image.height*
            scale
          )
        );

      const context=
        canvas.getContext(
          '2d'
        );

      context.drawImage(
        image,
        0,
        0,
        canvas.width,
        canvas.height
      );

      const data=
        canvas.toDataURL(
          'image/jpeg',
          .80
        );

      return {
        nome:
          String(
            file.name||
            'imagem'
          )
            .replace(
              /\.[^.]+$/,
              ''
            )+
          '.jpg',
        mime:'image/jpeg',
        base64:
          data.split(',')[1],
        preview:data
      };

    }finally{
      URL.revokeObjectURL(
        url
      );
    }
  }

  function field_(label,node,hint=''){
    const wrap=el('label',undefined,'field');
    wrap.append(el('span',label),node);
    if(hint)wrap.append(el('small',hint,'hint'));
    return wrap;
  }

  function input_(type,value=''){
    const node=el('input');
    node.type=type;
    node.value=value===undefined?'':value;
    return node;
  }

  function select_(options,value=''){
    const node=el('select');
    options.forEach(item=>{
      const data=Array.isArray(item)?item:[item,item];
      node.append(new Option(data[1],data[0]));
    });
    node.value=value;
    return node;
  }

  return async function(ctx){
    const root=ctx.root;
    const cache=new Map();

    const head=el('div',undefined,'adm-v3-head');
    const copy=el('div');
    copy.append(
      el('h2','Administração'),
      el('p','Cada área é carregada somente quando aberta.','hint')
    );
    const tabs=el('div',undefined,'adm-v3-tabs');
    head.append(copy,tabs);

    const panel=el('div',undefined,'adm-v3-panel');
    root.append(head,panel);

    const defs=[
      ['usuarios','Usuários e permissões','adminUsuarios'],
      ['tags','Tags de tarefas','adminTags'],
      ['modelo','Modelo de minuta','adminIntegracoes'],
      ['apis','Integrações / APIs','adminIntegracoes'],
      ['imagens','Biblioteca de imagens','adminImagens'],
      ['config','Configurações','adminConfiguracoes']
    ];

    let active='usuarios';
    let seq=0;

    const getData_=async(action,force=false)=>{
      if(!force&&cache.has(action))return cache.get(action);
      const data=await call(action);
      cache.set(action,data);
      return data;
    };

    const invalidate_=action=>{
      cache.delete(action);
    };

    async function renderUsers_(data){
      panel.replaceChildren();

      const toolbar=el('div',undefined,'adm-v3-toolbar');
      const search=input_('search');
      search.placeholder='Buscar usuário por nome, usuário, função ou e-mail';
      const sync=button('Sincronizar acessos do Drive',async()=>{
        const result=await call('usuariosAcessosGoogleSincronizar',{},true);
        status(result.mensagem||'Acessos sincronizados.');
      },true);
      const add=button('+ Novo usuário',()=>selectUser_(null));
      toolbar.append(search,sync,add);

      const layout=el('div',undefined,'adm-users-v3-layout');
      const list=el('div',undefined,'adm-users-v3-list');
      const editor=el('div',undefined,'adm-users-v3-editor');
      layout.append(list,editor);
      panel.append(toolbar,layout);

      let selected=null;

      const renderList_=()=>{
        const term=String(search.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
        list.replaceChildren();

        const rows=(data.usuarios||[]).filter(user=>
          !term||
          [user.nome,user.nomeUsuario,user.funcao,user.email,user.perfil,user.entidade]
            .join(' ')
            .toLowerCase()
            .includes(term)
        );

        rows.forEach(user=>{
          const item=el('button',undefined,'adm-user-v3-item');
          item.type='button';
          item.classList.toggle('active',selected&&selected.id===user.id);
          const name=el('strong',user.nome||user.email);
          const meta=el('small',[
            user.funcao||'sem função',
            user.perfil,
            user.ativo==='true'?'ativo':'inativo'
          ].join(' · '));
          item.append(name,meta);
          item.onclick=()=>selectUser_(user);
          list.append(item);
        });

        if(!rows.length){
          list.append(el('p','Nenhum usuário encontrado.','hint'));
        }
      };

      const selectUser_=user=>{
        selected=user;
        renderList_();
        editor.replaceChildren();

        const isNew=!user;
        const source=user||{
          nome:'',
          funcao:'',
          email:'',
          nomeUsuario:'',
          perfil:'CONSULTA',
          ativo:'true',
          permissoesEfetivas:['consulta']
        };

        const editorHead=el('div',undefined,'adm-user-editor-head');
        editorHead.append(
          el('h3',isNew?'Novo usuário':source.nome||source.email)
        );

        if(!isNew){
          const removeTop=button(
            'Excluir usuário',
            async()=>{
              if(!window.confirm('Excluir definitivamente '+(source.nome||source.email)+'?'))return;
              const typed=window.prompt('Digite o e-mail para confirmar:\n'+source.email);
              if(String(typed||'').trim().toLowerCase()!==String(source.email).toLowerCase()){
                throw new Error('O e-mail de confirmação não confere.');
              }
              const result=await call(
                'usuarioExcluir',
                {id:source.id,versao:source.versao},
                true
              );
              invalidate_('adminUsuarios');
              const fresh=await getData_('adminUsuarios',true);
              data=fresh;
              renderUsers_(fresh);
              status(result.mensagem||'Usuário excluído.');
            },
            true
          );
          removeTop.classList.add('danger','adm-user-delete-top');
          editorHead.append(removeTop);
        }

        editor.append(editorHead);

        const form=el('form',undefined,'adm-user-v3-form');
        const name=input_('text',source.nome||'');
        name.required=true;
        const func=input_('text',source.funcao||'');
        func.required=true;
        const email=input_('email',source.email||'');
        email.required=true;
        if(!isNew)email.readOnly=true;

        const username=input_(
          'text',
          source.nomeUsuario||
          ''
        );
        username.required=true;
        username.minLength=3;
        username.maxLength=40;
        username.placeholder='ex.: coloniaz3';
        username.autocomplete='off';

        const profile=select_(
          (data.perfis||[]).map(value=>[
            value,
            value==='COLONIA_PESCADOR'
              ?'COLÔNIA DE PESCADOR'
              :value
          ]),
          source.perfil||'CONSULTA'
        );

        const entity=select_(
          [
            ['','Selecione uma entidade'],
            ...(data.entidades||[]).map(value=>[value,value])
          ],
          source.entidade||''
        );

        const entityField=
          field_(
            'Entidade vinculada',
            entity
          );

        const activeBox=input_('checkbox');
        activeBox.checked=source.ativo===true||source.ativo==='true';

        const basics=el('div',undefined,'adm-user-v3-basics');
        basics.append(
          field_('Nome',name),
          field_('Função',func),
          field_('Nome de usuário',username),
          field_('E-mail',email),
          field_('Perfil-base',profile),
          entityField,
          field_('Ativo',activeBox)
        );

        const permissionBox=el('div',undefined,'adm-permission-v3-grid');
        const controls=new Map();

        const syncProfile_=()=>{
          const defaults=
            (data.perfisDetalhes[profile.value]&&
             data.perfisDetalhes[profile.value].permissoes)||
            ['consulta'];

          (data.permissoes||[]).forEach(permission=>{
            const control=controls.get(permission.key);
            if(control)control.checked=defaults.includes(permission.key);
          });

          const required=controls.get('consulta');
          if(required){
            required.checked=true;
            required.disabled=true;
          }

          const colony=
            profile.value==='COLONIA_PESCADOR';

          entityField.hidden=!colony;
          entity.required=colony;

          if(!colony){
            entity.value='';
          }
        };

        (data.permissoes||[]).forEach(permission=>{
          const label=el('label',undefined,'adm-permission-v3-item');
          const control=input_('checkbox');
          control.checked=(source.permissoesEfetivas||[]).includes(permission.key);
          controls.set(permission.key,control);
          const text=el('span');
          text.append(
            el('strong',permission.label),
            el('small',permission.descricao||'')
          );
          label.append(control,text);
          permissionBox.append(label);
        });

        const consultation=controls.get('consulta');
        if(consultation){
          consultation.checked=true;
          consultation.disabled=true;
        }

        if(isNew){
          syncProfile_();
        }

        profile.addEventListener('change',syncProfile_);

        const syncEntityVisibility_=()=>{
          const colony=
            profile.value==='COLONIA_PESCADOR';

          entityField.hidden=!colony;
          entity.required=colony;

          if(!colony){
            entity.value='';
          }
        };

        profile.addEventListener(
          'change',
          syncEntityVisibility_
        );

        syncEntityVisibility_();

        const actions=el('div',undefined,'actions');
        const save=el('button',isNew?'Autorizar usuário':'Salvar usuário');
        save.type='submit';
        actions.append(save);

        const normalized=String(source.funcao||'').trim().toLowerCase();
        if(
          !isNew&&
          (normalized==='professor'||normalized==='residente')
        ){
          actions.append(
            button(
              'Aplicar poderes padrão de Professor/Residente',
              async()=>{
                const result=await call(
                  'usuarioAprovarProfessorResidente',
                  {id:source.id,versao:source.versao},
                  true
                );
                status('Poderes funcionais atualizados.');
                invalidate_('adminUsuarios');
                const fresh=await getData_('adminUsuarios',true);
                data=fresh;
                renderUsers_(fresh);
              },
              true
            )
          );
        }

        if(!isNew){
          actions.append(
            button(
              'Redefinir senha',
              async()=>{
                const novaSenha=
                  window.prompt(
                    'Defina a nova senha para '+
                    (
                      source.nome||
                      source.nomeUsuario||
                      source.email
                    )+
                    ':'
                  );

                if(novaSenha===null){
                  return;
                }

                if(novaSenha.length===0){
                  throw new Error(
                    'Informe a nova senha.'
                  );
                }

                const result=
                  await call(
                    'usuarioRedefinirSenha',
                    {
                      id:source.id,
                      versao:source.versao,
                      senha:novaSenha
                    },
                    true
                  );

                status(
                  result.mensagem||
                  'Senha redefinida.'
                );

                invalidate_(
                  'adminUsuarios'
                );

                const fresh=
                  await getData_(
                    'adminUsuarios',
                    true
                  );

                data=fresh;
                renderUsers_(fresh);
              },
              true
            )
          );
        }

        if(!isNew){
          const remove=button(
            'Excluir usuário',
            async()=>{
              if(!window.confirm('Excluir definitivamente '+(source.nome||source.email)+'?'))return;
              const typed=window.prompt('Digite o e-mail para confirmar:\n'+source.email);
              if(String(typed||'').trim().toLowerCase()!==String(source.email).toLowerCase()){
                throw new Error('O e-mail de confirmação não confere.');
              }
              await call(
                'usuarioExcluir',
                {id:source.id,versao:source.versao},
                true
              );
              invalidate_('adminUsuarios');
              const fresh=await getData_('adminUsuarios',true);
              data=fresh;
              renderUsers_(fresh);
              status('Usuário excluído.');
            },
            true
          );
          remove.classList.add('danger');
          actions.append(remove);
        }

        form.append(basics,el('h4','Permissões'),permissionBox,actions);

        form.onsubmit=async event=>{
          event.preventDefault();
          const permissions=(data.permissoes||[])
            .filter(permission=>{
              const control=controls.get(permission.key);
              return control&&control.checked;
            })
            .map(permission=>permission.key);

          await call(
            'usuarioSalvar',
            {
              id:source.id||'',
              versao:source.versao||'',
              nome:name.value,
              funcao:func.value,
              nomeUsuario:username.value,
              email:email.value,
              perfil:profile.value,
              entidade:entity.value,
              ativo:activeBox.checked,
              permissoes:permissions
            },
            true
          );

          invalidate_('adminUsuarios');
          App.state.boot=await call('bootstrap',{light:true});
          const fresh=await getData_('adminUsuarios',true);
          data=fresh;
          renderUsers_(fresh);
          status(isNew?'Usuário autorizado.':'Usuário atualizado.');
        };

        editor.append(form);
      };

      search.addEventListener('input',renderList_);
      renderList_();
      if(data.usuarios&&data.usuarios.length)selectUser_(data.usuarios[0]);
      else selectUser_(null);
    }

    async function renderTags_(data){
      panel.replaceChildren();
      const head=el('div',undefined,'adm-v3-toolbar');
      head.append(
        el('p','As cores das tags aparecem nos cards e botões das tarefas.','hint'),
        button('+ Nova tag',()=>openTag_(null))
      );
      const grid=el('div',undefined,'adm-tags-grid-v3');
      panel.append(head,grid);

      const openTag_=tag=>{
        const row=el('form',undefined,'adm-tag-editor-v3');
        const name=input_('text',tag&&tag.nome||'');
        name.placeholder='Nome da tag';
        const color=input_('color',tag&&tag.cor||'#176e7d');
        const activeBox=input_('checkbox');
        activeBox.checked=!tag||tag.ativo===true||tag.ativo==='true';

        const save=el('button','Salvar');
        save.type='submit';
        row.append(
          field_('Nome',name),
          field_('Cor',color),
          field_('Ativa',activeBox),
          save
        );

        if(tag&&!tag.padrao){
          row.append(
            button(
              'Excluir',
              async()=>{
                if(!window.confirm('Excluir a tag '+tag.nome+'?'))return;
                await call('tarefaTagExcluir',{id:tag.id},true);
                invalidate_('adminTags');
                renderTags_(await getData_('adminTags',true));
              },
              true
            )
          );
        }

        row.onsubmit=async event=>{
          event.preventDefault();
          await call(
            'tarefaTagSalvar',
            {
              id:tag&&tag.padrao?'':tag&&tag.id||'',
              nome:name.value,
              cor:color.value,
              ativo:activeBox.checked
            },
            true
          );
          invalidate_('adminTags');
          renderTags_(await getData_('adminTags',true));
          status('Tag salva.');
        };

        grid.prepend(row);
      };

      (data.tagsTarefas||[]).forEach(tag=>{
        const row=el('div',undefined,'adm-tag-row-v3');
        const chip=el('span',tag.nome,'adm-tag-chip-v3');
        chip.style.setProperty('--tag-color',tag.cor||'#176e7d');
        row.append(
          chip,
          el('small',tag.ativo===false||tag.ativo==='false'?'inativa':'ativa'),
          button('Editar',()=>openTag_(tag),true)
        );
        grid.append(row);
      });
    }

    async function renderModel_(data){
      panel.replaceChildren();
      const box=el('section',undefined,'card adm-v3-card');
      box.append(el('h3','Modelo de minuta'));

      if(data.modelo&&data.modelo.configurado){
        box.append(
          el('p','Modelo ativo: '+data.modelo.nome,'badge')
        );
      }else{
        box.append(
          el('p',(data.modelo&&data.modelo.mensagem)||'Nenhum modelo ativo.','warn')
        );
      }

      const input=input_('file');
      input.accept='.docx,application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document';
      const send=button('Enviar e ativar modelo',async()=>{
        const file=input.files&&input.files[0];
        if(!file)throw new Error('Selecione o arquivo DOCX.');
        if(file.size>10*1024*1024)throw new Error('O arquivo deve ter no máximo 10 MB.');
        const result=await call(
          'modeloUpload',
          {
            nome:file.name,
            mime:file.type||'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
            base64:await readFile_(file)
          },
          true
        );
        status(result.mensagem||'Modelo ativado.');
        invalidate_('adminIntegracoes');
        renderModel_(await getData_('adminIntegracoes',true));
      });

      box.append(
        el('p','Envie somente o DOCX oficial. A conversão e a validação são feitas no servidor.','hint'),
        input,
        send
      );
      panel.append(box);
    }

    async function renderApis_(data){
      panel.replaceChildren();

      const portal=el('section',undefined,'card adm-v3-card');
      portal.append(
        el('h3','Portal da Transparência'),
        el('p',data.portalTransparencia&&data.portalTransparencia.configurada?'Chave configurada.':'Chave não configurada.',data.portalTransparencia&&data.portalTransparencia.configurada?'badge':'warn')
      );
      const portalKey=input_('password');
      portalKey.placeholder='Nova chave da API';
      portal.append(
        field_('Chave',portalKey),
        button('Salvar chave',async()=>{
          const result=await call('portalApiKeySalvar',{chave:portalKey.value},true);
          portalKey.value='';
          status(result.mensagem||'Chave salva.');
          invalidate_('adminIntegracoes');
        })
      );

      const deep=el('section',undefined,'card adm-v3-card');
      deep.append(
        el('h3','DeepSeek — leitura de documentos'),
        el('p',data.deepseek&&data.deepseek.configurada?'Chave configurada. Modelo: '+data.deepseek.modelo+'.':'Chave não configurada.',data.deepseek&&data.deepseek.configurada?'badge':'warn')
      );
      const deepKey=input_('password');
      deepKey.placeholder='Nova chave DeepSeek';
      deep.append(
        field_('Chave',deepKey),
        button('Salvar chave',async()=>{
          const result=await call('deepseekApiKeySalvar',{chave:deepKey.value},true);
          deepKey.value='';
          status(result.mensagem||'Chave salva.');
          invalidate_('adminIntegracoes');
        })
      );

      panel.append(portal,deep);
    }

    async function renderImages_(data){
      panel.replaceChildren();

      const intro=
        el(
          'section',
          undefined,
          'card adm-v3-card adm-images-intro'
        );

      intro.append(
        el(
          'h3',
          'Biblioteca visual do Povo das Águas'
        ),
        el(
          'p',
          'As imagens ficam armazenadas no Google Drive. O sistema carrega apenas a fotografia necessária para cada tela, evitando prejudicar o desempenho.',
          'hint'
        )
      );

      const upload=
        el(
          'form',
          undefined,
          'adm-image-upload'
        );

      const files=
        input_(
          'file'
        );

      files.accept=
        'image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp';

      files.multiple=true;

      const uses=
        [
          ['LOGIN','Login'],
          ['PAINEL','Painel'],
          ['TERRITORIO','Território / fundos'],
          ['INSTITUCIONAL','Institucional']
        ];

      const useBox=
        el(
          'div',
          undefined,
          'adm-image-uses'
        );

      uses.forEach(
        ([value,label])=>{
          const wrapper=
            el(
              'label',
              undefined,
              'adm-image-use'
            );

          const check=
            input_(
              'checkbox'
            );

          check.value=value;
          check.checked=
            value==='LOGIN'||
            value==='PAINEL';

          wrapper.append(
            check,
            el(
              'span',
              label
            )
          );

          useBox.append(
            wrapper
          );
        }
      );

      const uploadButton=
        el(
          'button',
          'Adicionar imagens'
        );

      uploadButton.type='submit';

      upload.append(
        field_(
          'Fotos',
          files,
          'É possível selecionar várias imagens de uma vez. Elas serão redimensionadas e comprimidas no navegador antes do envio.'
        ),
        field_(
          'Onde podem aparecer',
          useBox
        ),
        uploadButton
      );

      intro.append(upload);
      panel.append(intro);

      const count=
        el(
          'p',
          String(
            data.quantidade||
            0
          )+
          ' imagem(ns) na biblioteca.',
          'hint adm-image-count'
        );

      panel.append(count);

      const grid=
        el(
          'div',
          undefined,
          'adm-image-grid'
        );

      const renderRows_=()=>{
        grid.replaceChildren();

        const rows=
          data.imagens||
          [];

        if(!rows.length){
          grid.append(
            el(
              'p',
              'Nenhuma imagem cadastrada.',
              'hint'
            )
          );
          return;
        }

        rows.forEach(
          item=>{
            const card=
              el(
                'article',
                undefined,
                'adm-image-card'+
                (
                  item.ativo
                    ?''
                    :' is-disabled'
                )
              );

            const preview=
              el(
                'div',
                undefined,
                'adm-image-preview'
              );

            preview.append(
              el(
                'span',
                'Carregar prévia',
                'hint'
              )
            );

            let previewLoaded=false;

            preview.onclick=
              async()=>{
                if(previewLoaded){
                  return;
                }

                previewLoaded=true;
                preview.classList.add(
                  'is-loading'
                );

                try{
                  const image=
                    await call(
                      'imagemSistemaConteudo',
                      {id:item.id},
                      false,
                      {noLoader:true}
                    );

                  if(!image)return;

                  preview.replaceChildren();

                  const node=
                    el(
                      'img'
                    );

                  node.alt=
                    item.legenda||
                    item.nome||
                    '';

                  node.src=
                    'data:'+
                    image.mime+
                    ';base64,'+
                    image.base64;

                  preview.append(node);

                }catch(error){
                  previewLoaded=false;
                  preview.replaceChildren(
                    el(
                      'span',
                      'Não foi possível carregar a prévia.',
                      'warn'
                    )
                  );

                }finally{
                  preview.classList.remove(
                    'is-loading'
                  );
                }
              };

            const title=
              el(
                'strong',
                item.nome
              );

            const legend=
              input_(
                'text',
                item.legenda||
                ''
              );

            legend.placeholder=
              'Legenda opcional';

            const activeBox=
              input_(
                'checkbox'
              );

            activeBox.checked=
              item.ativo!==false;

            const usageGrid=
              el(
                'div',
                undefined,
                'adm-image-card-uses'
              );

            const controls=[];

            uses.forEach(
              ([value,label])=>{
                const wrapper=
                  el(
                    'label'
                  );

                const check=
                  input_(
                    'checkbox'
                  );

                check.value=value;
                check.checked=
                  (
                    item.usos||
                    []
                  )
                    .includes(
                      value
                    );

                controls.push(
                  check
                );

                wrapper.append(
                  check,
                  el(
                    'span',
                    label
                  )
                );

                usageGrid.append(
                  wrapper
                );
              }
            );

            const actions=
              el(
                'div',
                undefined,
                'actions'
              );

            actions.append(
              button(
                'Salvar',
                async()=>{
                  const result=
                    await call(
                      'imagemSistemaSalvar',
                      {
                        id:item.id,
                        ativo:
                          activeBox.checked,
                        legenda:
                          legend.value,
                        usos:
                          controls
                            .filter(
                              control=>
                                control.checked
                            )
                            .map(
                              control=>
                                control.value
                            )
                      },
                      true
                    );

                  Object.assign(
                    item,
                    result
                  );

                  status(
                    'Imagem atualizada.'
                  );
                },
                true
              ),
              button(
                'Excluir',
                async()=>{
                  if(
                    !window.confirm(
                      'Excluir esta imagem da biblioteca?'
                    )
                  ){
                    return;
                  }

                  await call(
                    'imagemSistemaExcluir',
                    {id:item.id},
                    true
                  );

                  data.imagens=
                    (
                      data.imagens||
                      []
                    )
                      .filter(
                        row=>
                          row.id!==
                          item.id
                      );

                  data.quantidade=
                    data.imagens.length;

                  count.textContent=
                    data.quantidade+
                    ' imagem(ns) na biblioteca.';

                  renderRows_();

                  status(
                    'Imagem excluída.'
                  );
                },
                true
              )
            );

            card.append(
              preview,
              title,
              field_(
                'Legenda',
                legend
              ),
              field_(
                'Ativa',
                activeBox
              ),
              usageGrid,
              actions
            );

            grid.append(card);
          }
        );
      };

      panel.append(grid);
      renderRows_();

      upload.onsubmit=
        async event=>{
          event.preventDefault();

          const selected=
            Array.from(
              files.files||
              []
            );

          if(!selected.length){
            throw new Error(
              'Selecione ao menos uma imagem.'
            );
          }

          const selectedUses=
            Array.from(
              useBox.querySelectorAll(
                'input:checked'
              )
            )
              .map(
                control=>
                  control.value
              );

          if(!selectedUses.length){
            throw new Error(
              'Selecione ao menos um local de uso.'
            );
          }

          uploadButton.disabled=true;

          try{
            let uploaded=0;

            for(const file of selected){
              uploadButton.textContent=
                'Otimizando '+
                (
                  uploaded+
                  1
                )+
                ' de '+
                selected.length+
                '…';

              const prepared=
                await optimizeImage_(
                  file
                );

              const row=
                await call(
                  'imagemSistemaUpload',
                  {
                    nome:
                      prepared.nome,
                    mime:
                      prepared.mime,
                    base64:
                      prepared.base64,
                    usos:
                      selectedUses
                  },
                  true,
                  {silent:true}
                );

              data.imagens=
                [
                  ...(
                    data.imagens||
                    []
                  ),
                  row
                ];

              uploaded++;
            }

            data.quantidade=
              data.imagens.length;

            files.value='';

            count.textContent=
              data.quantidade+
              ' imagem(ns) na biblioteca.';

            renderRows_();

            status(
              uploaded+
              (
                uploaded===1
                  ?' imagem adicionada.'
                  :' imagens adicionadas.'
              )
            );

          }finally{
            uploadButton.disabled=false;
            uploadButton.textContent=
              'Adicionar imagens';
          }
        };
    }

    async function renderConfig_(data){
      panel.replaceChildren();
      const rows=data.configuracoes||[];
      const editable=[
        ['rascunhos','Política de rascunhos'],
        ['vencimentoFuturo','Vencimento futuro'],
        ['anexoOrientacao','Orientação de anexo'],
        ['entidades','Entidades'],
        ['municipios','Municípios'],
        ['demandas','Demandas'],
        ['categorias','Categorias'],
        ['situacoes','Situações']
      ];

      const grid=el('div',undefined,'adm-config-v3-grid');

      editable.forEach(([key,label])=>{
        const row=rows.find(item=>item.chave===key);
        let value=data.config&&data.config[key];

        const form=el('form',undefined,'adm-config-v3-item');
        form.append(el('strong',label));

        let control;
        if(Array.isArray(value)){
          control=el('textarea');
          control.rows=5;
          control.value=value.join('\n');
        }else if(key==='rascunhos'){
          control=select_(['PENDENTE','PERMITIR','PROIBIR'],String(value||'PENDENTE'));
        }else if(key==='vencimentoFuturo'){
          control=select_(['PENDENTE','ACEITAR','RECUSAR'],String(value||'PENDENTE'));
        }else{
          control=input_('text',value||'');
        }

        const save=el('button','Salvar');
        save.type='submit';
        form.append(control,save);

        form.onsubmit=async event=>{
          event.preventDefault();
          let next=control.value;
          if(Array.isArray(value)){
            next=String(control.value||'')
              .split(/\r?\n/)
              .map(item=>item.trim())
              .filter(Boolean);
          }

          await call(
            'configSalvar',
            {
              chave:key,
              valor:next,
              versao:row&&row.versao||''
            },
            true
          );

          invalidate_('adminConfiguracoes');
          const fresh=await getData_('adminConfiguracoes',true);
          renderConfig_(fresh);
          status('Configuração salva.');
        };

        grid.append(form);
      });

      panel.append(grid);
    }

    const renderTab_=async(key,force=false)=>{
      active=key;
      tabs.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(node=>
        node.classList.toggle('active',node.dataset.tab===key)
      );

      panel.replaceChildren(
        el('div','Carregando '+defs.find(item=>item[0]===key)[1]+'…','adm-v3-loading')
      );

      const def=defs.find(item=>item[0]===key);
      const data=await getData_(def[2],force);
      if(!alive(ctx)||active!==key)return;

      if(key==='usuarios')return renderUsers_(data);
      if(key==='tags')return renderTags_(data);
      if(key==='modelo')return renderModel_(data);
      if(key==='apis')return renderApis_(data);
      if(key==='imagens')return renderImages_(data);
      return renderConfig_(data);
    };

    defs.forEach(([key,label])=>{
      const tab=button(label,()=>renderTab_(key),true);
      tab.dataset.tab=key;
      if(key===active)tab.classList.add('active');
      tabs.append(tab);
    });

    /*
     * O shell já está visível. Usuários é a única consulta inicial e costuma
     * estar aquecida pelo preload; demais áreas permanecem totalmente lazy.
     */
    await renderTab_('usuarios');
  };
})();
</script>
